correctness.rationale: All 2^16 vertex subsets of each graph were exhaustively checked by two independent forest predicates, all graph incidences validated, and an explicit matching topologically sorted across 34,656 and 32,608 face incidences. The integral signed Morse boundary from degree 6 to 5 is zero; rank-complete unit minors of the degree 5-to-4 boundary have determinants +1 and -1. One critical point and no cells below degree 4 allow a cell-attachment argument via homotopy groups of sphere wedges. Independent ordinary mod-two simplicial boundary ranks corroborate homology; they are not used as an integral proof. See verify.py and verify_output.txt.

value.rationale: The endpoint of the forest filtration is a natural simplicial invariant encoding induced acyclicity and feedback vertex sets. The two exceptional, canonical SRG(16,6,2,2) graphs have matching degree/common-neighbor counts, triangle counts and induced forest cutoff, yet the complete integral homotopy classifications differ in both nonzero dimensions. Unimodular reduction supplies torsion-free homotopy types rather than just Euler characteristics or field-dependent Betti numbers.
